note.note:
I’m ready to generate the Problem List Clinical Note, but I don’t have the transcript or the DDx content in your message. Please provide:

- The patient transcript (the actual doctor–patient dialogue) 
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format

What to include or paste:
- Transcript: full text of the encounter including presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, ROS details, past medical history, allergies, current medications, social history, physical examination findings, and any stated impressions or plans.
- DDx: the JSON block with the differential diagnoses as provided by the diagnostic reasoning model.

Tips to ensure accuracy:
- Do not introduce new facts beyond what is in the transcript or DDx.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, we will record the name and note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If transcript and DDx conflict, we will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- All notes should be in American English, concise, professional, with the exact structure and headings you requested.

Once you provide the transcript and DDx, I will produce:
- Consult Summary (two-line)
- Problem List with up to three issues (per your structure), including: description, timeline, systems review, social history/meds/exam findings, consistent DDx with likelihood tags and brief justification
- Medications
- Allergies
- Past Medical History
- Social History
- Preventative History
- Physical Examination
- Plan
- Quality checks section at the bottom (documentQuality): including missing elements, any conflicts, and notes on transcript quality.
